plugins.name: block-auth-card
plugins.summary: Sign-in and sign-up card shell with logo, alternative actions, form slot, footer, and legal text.
plugins.description: A Web block that frames authentication pages: brand mark, page heading, optional alternative sign-in actions with a divider, a slot for the caller's form, a footer line for switching between sign-in and sign-up, and legal text. It contains no authentication logic: the existing auth feature's forms and session handling stay in charge. Built from the Card and Separator primitives and theme tokens; all copy arrives through props.
use_when: sign-in, sign-up, or password pages need a consistent framed layout
the builder asks for a login or registration card design
single sign-on buttons should sit above the email form with a divider

plugins.name: block-dashboard-stats
plugins.summary: KPI cards with values, accessible trends, icons, and a loading state for dashboards.
plugins.description: A Web block that renders a responsive grid of KPI cards: label, value, optional icon, an optional trend whose color follows whether the change is good news, a secondary line, and skeleton cards while loading. Built from the Card and Skeleton primitives and theme tokens; all copy arrives through props and it fetches nothing.
use_when: a dashboard or overview page needs headline numbers
the builder asks for KPI, metric, or stat cards with a trend
a console home page should summarize usage, revenue, or activity

plugins.name: block-data-table
plugins.summary: Sortable, paginated table shell generic over the row type, with aria-sort and an empty state.
plugins.description: A Web client block that renders typed columns over the rows passed in: sortable headers with aria-sort, optional row-header cells, client-side pagination with labelled controls and an announced page status, and an empty state across all columns. Built from the Table and Button primitives and theme tokens; all copy arrives through props and it fetches nothing.
use_when: a page lists records such as members, orders, invoices, or audit entries
the builder asks for a sortable or paginated table
a list needs an empty state and accessible sorting without a heavy grid library

plugins.name: block-empty-state
plugins.summary: Empty, no-results, error, and no-access state panels with recovery actions.
plugins.description: A Web block for the moments a page has nothing to show: empty collections, empty search results, failed loads (announced as an alert, with an optional request id), and missing access. Each variant has its own decorative icon and tone; title, description, and actions arrive through props, and a bare mode fits inside cards and table cells. Built from theme tokens and lucide-react icons; it fetches nothing.
use_when: a list, table, or search can be empty and should guide the user to a next step
a page needs a consistent error or no-access panel with a retry action
the builder asks for empty, error, or permission states

plugins.name: block-landing-hero
plugins.summary: Landing page hero with eyebrow, heading, calls to action, optional media, and a feature grid.
plugins.description: A Web block for the top of a public landing page: an eyebrow badge, the page heading, supporting copy, primary and secondary calls to action, optional media beside the copy on wide screens, and a responsive feature grid with decorative icons. Built from the Badge primitive and theme tokens; all copy and actions arrive through props and it fetches nothing.
use_when: a public home or product page needs a headline section with calls to action
the builder asks for a landing page, hero, or marketing section
key features should be presented in a grid under the headline

plugins.name: block-onboarding-steps
plugins.summary: Onboarding checklist with a progress bar, step states, and an action on the current step.
plugins.description: A Web block that renders an onboarding checklist: a progress bar with an accessible label, an ordered list of complete, current, and upcoming steps announced in words, aria-current on the current step, and an action slot on that step. Step status comes from the caller; built from the Card primitives, theme tokens, and lucide-react icons; all copy arrives through props and it fetches nothing.
use_when: new users or organizations should see what to set up next
the builder asks for a getting-started checklist or stepper
a console home page needs setup progress until the account is ready

plugins.name: block-pricing-table
plugins.summary: Pricing plans with feature lists, a highlighted plan, and call-to-action slots.
plugins.description: A Web block that renders plan cards: name, description, a preformatted price and period, a feature list that announces included and missing features in words, a call-to-action slot, and one highlighted plan with a badge. Built from the Card and Badge primitives and theme tokens; prices and copy arrive through props and it fetches nothing.
use_when: a public site or upgrade page must show plans and prices
the builder asks for a pricing table or plan comparison
one plan should be recommended with a highlight

plugins.name: block-settings-page
plugins.summary: Sectioned settings layout with page header, section navigation, and framed sections with footers.
plugins.description: A Web block that lays out a settings page: a heading with optional actions, a section navigation that is a sticky sidebar on wide screens and a horizontal strip on phones, and one labelled card per section with an optional action footer and a danger tone for irreversible settings. Built from the Card primitives and theme tokens; forms and copy arrive through props and it fetches nothing.
use_when: a product needs an account, workspace, or organization settings page
several groups of preferences should share one page with navigation
the builder asks for a settings layout with a danger zone

plugins.name: knowledge-base
plugins.summary: Organization knowledge articles with full-text and substring search.
plugins.description: Adds a knowledge starter: organization owners and admins write Markdown articles, every member reads and searches them. Search ranks full-text matches and also finds substrings, so it works for languages written without spaces, such as Chinese. Writes use optimistic concurrency (If-Match) and record audit changes without article text.
use_when: the team needs a knowledge base, wiki, FAQ, or help center
members must search shared documents, including Chinese text
a later AI feature needs a store of organization documents to answer from

plugins.name: theme-enterprise
plugins.summary: Calm blue enterprise theme for Web and Admin: denser spacing, smaller radius, crisp borders.
plugins.description: Restyles the Web application and the Admin Console through design tokens only: a calm blue primary and brand, cool neutral surfaces, opaque crisp borders, a 0.375rem radius, a 4% denser Tailwind spacing unit, and less translucent Admin material. Light and dark mode are both covered and every checked readable pair meets WCAG AA 4.5:1. No component changes; remove the plugin to return to the default tokens.
use_when: the product is a business or internal tool and should look calm, trustworthy, and information dense
the builder asks for a corporate, enterprise, or blue look
tables and dashboards need slightly tighter spacing without changing components

plugins.name: theme-midnight
plugins.summary: Dark-leaning, high-contrast theme for Web and Admin: near-black navy and a vivid violet accent.
plugins.description: Restyles the Web application and the Admin Console through design tokens only: near-black navy surfaces, bright high-contrast text, clearly visible borders, and a vivid violet accent in dark mode; light mode keeps the identity with midnight-navy controls and deep ink text. Every checked readable pair meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 in both modes. No component changes; remove the plugin to return to the default tokens.
use_when: the product targets developers or night-time use and should look dark and bold
the builder asks for a dark, midnight, neon, or high-contrast look
the brand needs a vivid accent that stays readable on dark surfaces

plugins.name: theme-warm
plugins.summary: Content-first warm theme for Web and Admin: paper neutrals, ink text, terracotta accent, soft radius.
plugins.description: Restyles the Web application and the Admin Console through design tokens only: warm paper-like neutrals, ink-like text, a terracotta brand accent, and a softer radius suited to long-form reading such as documentation, knowledge bases, and content sites. Light and dark mode are both covered and every checked readable pair meets WCAG AA 4.5:1. No component changes; remove the plugin to return to the default tokens.
use_when: the product is content-first: documentation, a knowledge base, a blog, or a community
the builder asks for a warm, friendly, soft, or editorial look
long text should be comfortable to read in light and dark mode
